cards.title: Telemetry
cards.text: OpenTelemetry on core: a host opts in, and core alone sends nothing anywhere.

cards.title: The tracer
cards.text: Every turn, model request, tool call and HTTP call as a span, sent over OTLP.

cards.title: The log sink
cards.text: Every log line to the collector too, the record files left out.

cards.title: Own traffic out
cards.text: Our own calls to the collector are never traced, or every batch would be a span.
